title: Set a writing schedule you can keep

stage.name: Schedule
stage.description: Time is set aside, week after week.

intro: Books get finished by showing up.

questions.prompt: Which schedule helps most writers finish a book?
options: Regular, realistic sessions they can keep up
questions.why: Small, steady progress adds up faster than waiting for the perfect moment.

questions.prompt: Writing 300 words a day adds up to more than 100,000 words in a year.
What's a good way to protect writing time?
options: Put it on the calendar like an appointment
questions.why: Time that's planned is time that happens.

questions.prompt: Relationships need scheduled time too. Which habit is healthiest?
options: A regular time that's just for the two of you
Seeing each other only when nothing else is on
questions.why: Protected time together says “you matter” without a word.

talk: When could you have a regular time that's just for the two of you?
